sites.before: Peers on the same LAN discover each other via multicast scouting, sharing a single ref-counted `zenoh.Session` per process.
sites.after: Peers discover each other over gossip scouting, sharing a single ref-counted `zenoh.Session` per process. Cross-host peers need explicit `ZENOH_CONNECT` endpoints: LAN multicast scouting is off by default (`STRANDS_MESH_MULTICAST=true` opts in) because it lets any host on the network enroll itself into the fleet.

sites.before: 3. Zenoh scouting (multicast) handles LAN discovery automatically.
sites.after: 3. Zenoh gossip scouting propagates peers across already-connected sessions. LAN multicast scouting is off by default -- set ``STRANDS_MESH_MULTICAST=true`` to opt in -- so cross-host peers otherwise need explicit ``ZENOH_CONNECT`` endpoints.
